run_DINOv3_training: run DINOv3 self-supervised training with config file and distributed data parallel across GPUs
run_DINOv3_evaluation: run evaluation only mode on a trained DINOv3 model using pretrained weights and checkpoint
run_multidistillation_training: run multi-distillation training with SSLMetaArch or MultiDistillationMetaArch using the config file
build_optimizer: build an AdamW optimizer with configurable beta parameters from the training config and parameter groups
build_schedulers: build cosine decay schedules for learning rate, weight decay, momentum, and teacher temperature
